name: grim-mcp

tools.name: detect_stack
tools.description: Identify the project stack(s) and web-served directories. Run this first.

path.description: File, directory, or archive (tar.gz/zip) to scan

tools.name: audit_deps
tools.description: Find known CVEs in dependencies via the live OSV.dev database (npm, Composer, PyPI).

path.description: File, directory, or archive (tar.gz/zip) to scan

tools.name: scan_secrets
tools.description: Scan for leaked credentials, API keys, tokens, private keys, and sensitive files. Set include_history to also scan committed git history.

path.description: File, directory, or archive (tar.gz/zip) to scan

include_history.description: Also scan git history blobs for leaked secrets

tools.name: scan_code
tools.description: Static analysis for dangerous code patterns: client-controlled uploads, injection sinks, RCE preconditions.

path.description: File, directory, or archive (tar.gz/zip) to scan

languages.description: Filter by language: php, js, python, ruby, go, rust, java, kotlin, csharp, dart, c, cpp, objc, swift, scala, groovy, elixir, erlang, lua, perl, r, julia, nim, powershell, shell, hcl, dockerfile, clojure, haskell

use_cache.description: Reuse delta cache of unchanged files (default true)

tools.name: audit_exposure
tools.description: Detect exposed/executable/malicious files in web paths and archives: webshells, polyglots, ELF binaries, .env, backups. Set deep to descend into nested archives.

path.description: File, directory, or archive (tar.gz/zip) to scan

deep.description: Extract and scan nested archives (zip/tar inside zip/tar)

tools.name: diff_artifacts
tools.description: Compare two directories/archives (baseline vs current) to detect added, removed, or modified files - the active-compromise drift check.

tools.name: watch
tools.description: Persistent baseline and drift detection. action=save stores the current file manifest; action=diff compares the target to the saved baseline; action=status shows baseline info.

path.description: File, directory, or archive (tar.gz/zip) to scan

tools.name: fix_plan
tools.description: Turn findings into an ordered remediation plan, with safe unified-diff patches where a fix is deterministic. Accepts findings or a path to scan.

path.description: File, directory, or archive (tar.gz/zip) to scan

findings.description: Findings to plan for (alternative to path)

include_patches.description: Emit unified diffs for deterministic fixes (default true)

tools.description: Scan subset when planning from a path

network.description: Allow dependency CVE lookup during the scan

deep.description: Deep scan when planning from a path

tools.name: inventory_endpoints
tools.description: Enumerate application routes (Express, Laravel, Django, Go, Next.js, Astro) with method, auth middleware, input surface, and risk rank.

path.description: File, directory, or archive (tar.gz/zip) to scan

tools.name: check_live
tools.description: Opt-in live checks for an authorized host: security headers, cookies, TLS, and (if the scope allows) allowlisted exposed paths. Requires a scope (file or inline).

url.description: Target URL or host (must be authorized by the scope)

active.description: Allow active probes (also requires scope target mode=active)

tools.name: malware_scan
tools.description: Malware scan: built-in webshell/polyglot/ELF heuristics and IoC hashes, plus optional ClamAV and YARA if installed.

path.description: File, directory, or archive (tar.gz/zip) to scan

tools.name: plan
tools.description: Build an ordered, explainable audit plan for a target: which tools to run and why, based on detected stack and inputs.

path.description: File, directory, or archive (tar.gz/zip) to scan

network.description: Assume dependency CVE lookup is available (default true)

tools.name: sbom
tools.description: Generate a software bill of materials for resolved dependencies as CycloneDX 1.5 or SPDX 2.3 JSON.

path.description: File, directory, or archive (tar.gz/zip) to scan

tools.name: scan_iocs
tools.description: Hash files and match them against the known-bad IoC store. Detects known malware by content hash and the EICAR test file.

path.description: File, directory, or archive (tar.gz/zip) to scan

ioc_path.description: Override path to the IoC store JSON

tools.name: update_feeds
tools.description: Sync detection feeds: SAST rules and IoC hashes, from a URL or GRIM_FEEDS_URL. Feed is JSON: {version, rules:[...], iocs:[...]} or a bare IoC list.

ioc_path.description: Override path to the IoC store JSON

tools.name: ledger
tools.description: Persistent findings ledger: track first-seen, known, reopened, and resolved findings across audits. Actions: merge (default), read, status.

path.description: File, directory, or archive (tar.gz/zip) to scan

findings.description: Merge these findings instead of scanning

tools.description: Scan subset when merging from a path

network.description: Allow dependency CVE lookup during merge scan

tools.name: report
tools.description: Render findings into a unified Markdown or JSON report.

tools.name: scan
tools.description: One-shot audit: detect stack, then run exposure + secrets + code + deps and return ranked findings.

path.description: File, directory, or archive (tar.gz/zip) to scan

tools.description: Subset: exposure, secrets, code, deps, iocs

network.description: Allow network calls for dependency CVE lookup (default true)

tools.name: ci_scan
tools.description: CI gate: run a full scan and return an exit code (1 when findings at or above the fail_on severity exist). Pair with SARIF output for pipelines.

path.description: File, directory, or archive (tar.gz/zip) to scan

fail_on.description: Severity threshold that fails the build (default high)

tools.description: Subset: exposure, secrets, code, deps, iocs

format.description: Also return a rendered report under 'report' (sarif for pipelines)

instructions: GRIM audits code, dependencies, exposure, secrets, and active compromise. Start with detect_stack or plan, then run scan (one-shot) or individual tools. Findings include severity, confidence, evidence, remediation, and MITRE ATT&CK tags. If meta.truncated is true, results are incomplete: raise the relevant GRIM_MAX_* limit and re-run.
